maximumFiles.description: Ceiling of the captured source closure of the reader entry. Measured 408 files on 2026-11-22: 390 of them come through the one import of the repository cache store (withRepositoryCacheStoreV1) that the reader needs; the reader itself adds three files. The ceiling therefore tracks the store closure (it grew from 384 with the funding, journal and platform-contract modules) and is the store's bound with headroom, not a bound on the reader; the exclusion of publication and compiler capture is pinned by the forbidden list, not by the count.
